subject: MAP: runway actions for POC environment activation & peering coordination
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@datasite.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: runway actions for POC environment activation & peering coordination

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Per our MAP discussion I’m consolidating the next-runway actions so we can hit the evaluation window next week. Key items we need to close on from the Redwood side: API keys & org invite, IP allowlist ranges, and VPC peering acceptance.

I’ve attached a short tracker (MAP_actions_tracker_v1.xlsx) and a VPC peering template to make the handoff to your infra team straightforward. At a high level: 
- API keys: we’ll provision a scoped API key for the eval account once we receive the org-admin email.
- Org setup: invite your primary eval users (3 seats) to the org; we can auto-provision roles on acceptance.
- IP allowlist: please confirm the CIDR blocks you’ll permit; we need these to enable the secure prefix-KV cache and to avoid transient throttling.
- VPC peering: template attached — your infra only needs to fill the account ID and preferred peer subnet. We can complete async once infra confirms connectivity windows.

Proposed dates: provision keys & invites by Mon 11/16, IP allowlist confirmed by Tue 11/17, peering handshake by end of week (Fri 11/20). If any of these are a problem we can shift the eval start.

Action: Can you loop in your infra contact (or reply with the person to add) so we can send the peering template directly?

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: MAP_actions_tracker_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), vpc-peering-template.txt (text), redwood-poc-sow-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@datasite.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@datasite.com>, infra-team@datasite.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: runway actions for POC environment activation & peering coordination

Thanks Tessa — that plan looks sensible. A few quick notes from infra: 
1) We have a change freeze on Mon 11/16 between 08:00–12:00 PT for a security maintenance window; anything that touches firewall rules should avoid that slot.
2) Our preferred peer subnet is 10.40.0.0/20; we can open 10.40.0.0/24 for the initial handshake if that’s sufficient.
3) For the IP allowlist we’ll provide a CIDR bundle by EOD Monday (our network team is compiling).

I’m looping Sarah (our IT Ops lead) and infra-team so they see the peering template. Please send the peering template to infra-team@datasite.com and cc me.

Also — in terms of org invites, the eval admin will be sarah.lee@datasite.com; please send the invite to that address.

Alex
Alex Moreno
Director of Platform, DataSite

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@datasite.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: runway actions for POC environment activation & peering coordination

Alex — sent the org invite to sarah.lee@datasite.com from the redwood-team org. Once Sarah accepts I’ll generate an eval-scoped API key and drop it into the MAP tracker under the "Credentials" tab.

Soojin — can you confirm that the scoped key will have token expiration = 90 days and read/write to the eval model only? I’ll hold on publishing until you sign off.

Tessa — noted the maintenance window on Mon morning; we’ll avoid making firewall changes during 08:00–12:00 PT.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments referenced: none

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@datasite.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: alex.moreno@datasite.com, infra-team@datasite.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: runway actions for POC environment activation & peering coordination

Ben / Tessa — I accepted the invite this afternoon. Infra has confirmed the 10.40.0.0/24 temporary peering window and will post the full CIDR list by EOD tomorrow. They asked for the filled peering template back with our account ID and proposed route target — forwarding infra-team copy to you both.

We also have one ask from procurement: can Redwood provide a short one-pager that lists data retention for logs during the POC and confirms we can disable telemetry for the eval org? Procurement wants that before API keys go into staging. If you can attach that to the MAP tracker under "Compliance" that would be great.

Otherwise we’re green to start the eval on Thu 11/19 assuming peering and IP allowlist finalize tomorrow.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Lee
IT Operations Lead, DataSite
